points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: All eight readable raw packages have required contract artifacts.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Explicit examiner invocation passes all eight packages and report.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Metadata reports seven steady cases converged and Re200 periodic, but M015 inviscid last50 drag oscillates 0.001646–0.001893 and M080 inviscid lift rises0.000916–0.002436 despite Cd-only stopping. These limit confidence without proving DQ7.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Re200 measured St0.1801/Cd1.2424/Cl amplitude0.4902 is low against stated reference; selected inviscid force tails show significant sensitivity and M2 laminar drag differs from same-Mach inviscid. Numerical limits do not prove fabricated outputs.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Accepted 42-page report contains extensive figures; sole Re200 force plot compresses late Cd beneath startup, failing explicit late-lift/drag floor.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Detailed report is candid; clean-tip rank-study regeneration inconsistency remains.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Committed generated rank table is readable but raw rank-study inputs are absent at tip. Re200 metadata stamps configure-time revision339d65f, whose parser does not support --linear-check-interval used in the matching selected launch; the actual binary source is not established.

disqualification_flags.flag: Figure files misnamed (e.g., Mach image that actually plots pressure)
Report figures do not correspond to submitted field/CSV outputs
Placeholder, synthetic, or intentionally partial result files in scored case dirs
metadata.json marks incomplete or failed runs as successful
Debug outputs presented as final case results
